newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Former Moroccan Premier Maati Bouabid died.
newsitem.headline: Former Moroccan Premier Maati Bouabid died.

text.p: Former Moroccan prime minister, Maati Bouabid, leader of the centre-right Constitutional Union party (UC), died on Friday after a heart attack in his home town of Casablanca, the official MAP news agency said.
Bouabid, 69, was prime minister between 1981 and 1983.
He was a leading member of the opposition National Union of People's Forces before he set up the centre-right UC party in 1983, MAP said.
The UC has 54 deputies in the 333 seat parliament.
